//: Type-check-only config for `npm run typecheck` -- it never emits. `checkJs` + `strict` turn an
implicitly-any parameter, or a JSDoc type that contradicts the code, into a build failure. It
enforces type CORRECTNESS; it cannot enforce that annotations or prose are PRESENT (a stripped
JSDoc block still passes), so documentation completeness remains a review property.
`files` is an EXPLICIT list, never include/exclude globs, so the 241k-line generated bundle in api/,
the npm/ release copy and the two git submodules can never be pulled in. Every hand-written .js file
in the repo is listed. example/globals.d.ts supplies the one browser global (`ondewo_nlu_api`) that
example/client.js reads, so the browser example is type-checked like everything else.
eslint.config.mjs is not listed: it is an ESM config module for a tool that validates it at load
time, and `make eslint` fails loudly if it is broken.
